data.name: Farewell To Sunshower
data.detailed_description:
Once upon a time... Wait, this isn't a fairy tale.

One day in Japan, Rina dies in a ridiculous way. As if that wasn't bad enough, she wakes up in Purgatory (USA). Not Yomi, the Japanese underworld.

The angels tell her she's got a shot at getting back to the land of the living.

"Get to the River Lethe," they say.

Problem is, Purgatory is basically a vast wilderness. You know, it's crawling with the Seven Deadly Sins, monsters, and God-knows-what else.

Rina keeps moving for one very human reason:

she's got a date.

But… is the River Lethe really the best idea?

Features

Inspired by Dante's Divine Comedy, Farewell To Sunshower is a horror-fantasy RPG set in Purgatory. As Rina pushes deeper into this crooked afterlife, she must fight, survive, and grow stronger.

• Rina can find useful items to survive in this mysterious, crooked realm.

• Rina may encounter horrifying and dangerous creatures as she explores.

• And the Seven Deadly Sins may drop something unique and cool when they die.

• Angels going through the motions. Of course, there are still passionate newcomers who do their best to manage the afterlife.

• Or, if she is lucky, she may meet other wandering souls on the road, pilgrims like herself. But trying to kill them first before they try to kill her, is probably not a good idea.

• Don't mess up Purgatory too much.

• Death Penalty: Rina's level resets to 1, and she loses all her Sinful Echoes. But her hard-won items and overall progress remain.

• Featuring FANTASTIC tracks by PGN Music.

• A new horror-magic experience from the designer of Frozen Friday Night: The Eve.

• Visuals and gameplay with unique artwork, reminiscent of those Newgrounds games. (Old school!)

Then, have a happy, safe afterlife!

Warning

This horror game contains extremely brutal and violent content, including blood, murder, and dismemberment elements. Streamers should set their live streaming settings to allow only adults to watch while you're playing this game. The infirm, pregnant women, and children must not play this game. Additionally, this videogame may cause people with photosensitive epilepsy to convulse in seizures. Player discretion is advised.

The content of this videogame is purely fictional, is not intended to represent or depict any actual event, person, or entity, and any such similarities are purely coincidental. The makers and publishers of this game do not in any way endorse, condone or encourage engaging in any conduct depicted in this videogame.

All characters in this videogame do not represent any country, race, organization, gender, generation, and so on. Each of them is a unique individual.
